note:
Golden cases for Ferb's Kotlin port of the content fix (H2), from the frozen code (frozen-2), on
dev.txt and dev2.txt only (never the blind sets). Writes app/src/test/resources/content/golden-dev.json.

Each case: the words as said, the rewrite's answer (H2 typed JSON, Gemma's and Nano's; and A's line,
Ferb Link's fallback), the command, what Needle 3 sees, the tools routed (quotes masked), Needle 3's
recorded answer, and what the frozen code makes of it: the calls with the content mapped back,
and the guards that ask first. Plus ICU's Latin for each text (uconv 78.3), to check ICU4J's.
